title: Ordinal-Aware Calibration for Ordinal Classification
abstract: arXiv:2410.15658v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep neural networks frequently produce overconfident, miscalibrated predictions. In ordinal classification, predictions must also adhere to a unimodal and order-consistent structure, a requirement that has dominated prior work while overlooking calibration. We formalize this joint challenge as ordinal calibration for the first time and propose the Ordinal loss for Calibration and Unimodality (ORCU). Unlike incremental modular combinations, ORCU provides a concise, principled unification of distance-aware soft encoding and an ordinal-aware log-barrier extension on adjacent logit gaps. This coupling is theoretically synergetic: soft-encoded targets pre-condition the optimization landscape by providing a finite, full-support ordinal anchor for well-posed refinement, while the log-barrier extension preserves non-vanishing adjacent-gap gradients in the unimodality-feasible interior. translated_title: 面向序数分类的序数感知校准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2410.15658v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：深度神经网络经常产生过度自信且校准不佳的预测。在序数分类中，预测还必须遵循单峰和顺序一致的结构，这一要求主导了先前的研究，但忽视了校准问题。我们首次将这一联合挑战形式化为序数校准，并提出了用于校准和单峰性的序数损失（ORCU）。与增量模块化组合不同，ORCU提供了一种简洁且原则性的统一方法，结合了距离感知的软编码和相邻logit差距上的序数感知对数障碍扩展。这种耦合在理论上是协同的：软编码目标通过提供有限、全支撑的序数锚点来预处理优化景观，以实现良态细化，而对数障碍扩展则在单峰性可行内部保持非消失的相邻差距梯度。这使得对数障碍能够在不牺牲结构约束的情况下细化置信度。
tldr: 本文首次提出序数校准问题，并设计ORCU损失函数，通过软编码与对数障碍的协同耦合，同时实现预测的校准性和单峰性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ordinal calibration for the first time and proposes the ORCU loss, which synergistically combines soft encoding and a log-barrier to achieve both calibration and unimodality in ordinal classification.
